name: Forward Jump
instructions: Dip into a partial squat, swinging your arms back.
Jump forward for distance, swinging the arms forward.
Land softly with bent knees. A fundamental horizontal power drill.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: A beginner bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Forward Jump builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
